## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-10-05 — do not edit manually*

### Large Files (read once, fully)
*~31,000 tokens/session saved*
- These files are large. Read each one ONCE in full, with no offset/limit, before editing. After that, use the Edit results or a targeted Grep instead of re-reading: `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/orders/orders-workspace.tsx` (~25KB, was re-read 6x), `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/pos/pos-client.tsx` (~60KB, 3x), `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/promotions/page.tsx` (14x in slices), `customers/customers-workspace.tsx` (4x), `tests/fixtures/branch-purchase-functions.sql` (4x), `lib/receipts/shipping-label-markup.ts` (3x).
- Do not read these files in small slices (offset/limit chunks) and then re-read neighbouring ranges. One full read costs less than 3+ partial reads.

### Editing Workflow
*~12,101 tokens/session saved*
- Plan all changes to a file first, then apply them in one pass. Use a single Write of the full file, or one python script with an `edit(path, [(old, new), ...])` helper that preserves CRLF. Do not make 5-40 sequential single-hunk Edits.
- This applies especially to the hot files: orders-workspace.tsx (41 edits), promotions/page.tsx (34), pos-client.tsx (29), returns-workspace.tsx (23), customers-workspace.tsx (13), order-workspace-types.ts (10), customers/page.tsx (8), campaign-form.tsx (8), shipping-label-markup.ts (7), pos-workspace-flow.tsx (6), order-workspace-data.ts (6), tests/shipping-templates.test.mjs (6), pos-sale-completed.tsx (5), returns/page.tsx (5), customers/[id]/page.tsx (5).
- The same rule covers small files edited 3-4x: profile-form.tsx, profile/actions.ts, business-info-form.tsx, info-actions.ts, categories-client.tsx, pos-checkout-controls.tsx, marketing/page.tsx, dashboard/page.tsx, next.config.ts, shipping-html.ts, order-detail-controls.tsx, orders/[id]/page.tsx, components/product-picker.tsx, mobile/src/screens.tsx, and memory files.

### Commands
*~6,313 tokens/session saved*
- Type-check once, after ALL edits in a request are done, using `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` with no `| head` or `Select-Object -First N`. Truncated output caused 16+ re-runs (`| head -20`, `| Select-Object`, and plain variants).
- The Bash tool resets cwd to C:\Users\TUF\pos-system after each call, so `cd` again inside every command that targets another directory.
- `gh` is not installed. Check GitHub commit status with `curl https://api.github.com/repos/cheauy/pos-system/commits/<sha>/status`.

### Environment
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- An RTK hook rewrites Bash commands and prints `[rtk] /!\ No hook installed`. A grep or pipeline with no matches exits 1 and is reported as an error. Treat exit 1 plus that banner as "no match", not as a failure, and don't retry.
- The RTK hook path has broken backslashes (`C:UsersTUF...rtk.exe: command not found`). If that appears, run the command through the PowerShell tool instead of retrying it in Bash.
- If the auto-mode classifier returns "gave no verdict (error)", do not retry the same command 2-3 times. Continue with read-only tools, or tell the user the check is blocked. This happened 11 times across tsc, eslint, and SQL calls.

### Testing
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- `node --test` tests load TS through `loadTs` with explicit dependency mocks. Adding a new import to a source file breaks its tests with `Unmocked import <id>`.
- When you add an import, grep `tests/` for the source file name and add the mock in the same pass. Affected so far: pos-order-choices, user-manage-permissions-branch-safety, storefront-closure-and-returns, printer-rendering, online-status-atomic.
- `orders-workspace.tsx` has pre-existing eslint `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` errors (around lines 135-180). `promotions/page.tsx` has `Date.now` purity errors. Don't re-run eslint repeatedly to chase these unless asked.

### Supabase
*~2,000 tokens/session saved*
- Run SQL through the Supabase Management API from PowerShell, not by opening the dashboard SQL editor in the browser (that navigate loop repeated 3x and failed).
- Use `$env:SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (User scope), project ref `brovmukjnushuzcalkwm`, and `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/<ref>/database/query`.
- The JSON body must be `{"query": "<sql string>"}`, where query is a string. Read the SQL from a scratchpad .sql file with `Get-Content -Raw`. Production DDL still requires user approval.

### File Reads
*~9,000 tokens/session saved*
- Read these files in full, once per task, then work from context. Do not re-Read slices after each edit: `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/promotions/page.tsx` (11 reads), `customers/customers-workspace.tsx` (4 reads), `tests/fixtures/branch-purchase-functions.sql` (4 reads).
- The Edit tool fails if old_string doesn't match. You don't need to re-Read to check a successful edit.

### Type-check / Lint / Test
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- Type-check with `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` once, after the batch of edits for a feature. Do not run it after every few edits (ran 12x in one session). Show the full output rather than `Select-Object -First N`, then re-run it only to confirm fixes.
- Run eslint and `node --test tests/<file>` as separate commands, not chained after tsc. Many tests in `tests/*.mjs` assert on source strings, so after changing UI text or structure, grep `tests/` for the removed strings first.
- ESLint `react-hooks/purity` rejects `Date.now()` during render (it hit `promotions/page.tsx` twice). Compute `now` outside render or pass it in as a prop.

### Supabase SQL
*~2,500 tokens/session saved*
- Run SQL through the Supabase Management API (the same way as the `C:\Users\TUF\social-inbox` project). POST to `https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/brovmukjnushuzcalkwm/database/query` with token `$env:SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (User scope). The body must be `@{query = <string>} | ConvertTo-Json`, where query is a string, not an object.
- Write one reusable scratchpad script (`run-sql.ps1 <file.sql>`) and call it for each query. Do not rebuild the inline command every time (repeated 9x).
- Do not drive the Supabase dashboard SQL editor through the browser (navigated there 3x and failed). New migrations go in `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_<name>.sql`.

### Search Scope
*~300 tokens/session saved*
- When a Grep returns nothing (e.g., `currency` ran 3x with empty results), check the `path`/`glob` scope before retrying the same pattern. Point it at the specific `app/(dashboard)/dashboard/<module>/` directory.
- ripgrep does not support look-around without `--pcre2`, so avoid `(?=...)` patterns.
